__app_forumfortress_description: Forum Fortress protection for registrations, content, contact forms and moderation workflows.
ff_enabled_desc: Protect registrations, forum content, profile changes and the contact form with Forum Fortress.
ff_api_base_url_desc: Public API entry (for example https://api.ffapi.net). May round-robin across edge nodes.
ff_api_region_desc: Lock check traffic to a region, or use the recommended global network.
ff_allow_global_fallback_desc: After a regional retry fails, permit the global network. Processing may occur outside the selected region.
ff_preferred_endpoint_desc: Optional override for the API edge node Forum Fortress should prefer.
ff_timeout_desc: Maximum time to wait for API responses.
ff_fail_open_desc: Allow an action when the live check cannot complete. Turn this off to block when Forum Fortress is unavailable.
ff_send_ham_desc: Tell Forum Fortress when a moderator reverses a spam decision so the network can learn from the correction.
ff_block_reject_action_desc: Choose how a remote reject action handles blocked content. Delete removes it; hide keeps a recoverable soft-deleted copy when supported.
ff_registration_block_action_desc: Mark rejected keeps the account in IPS's native validating state for administrator review. Delete prevents or removes the account entirely.
ff_trusted_proxies_desc: Optional comma-separated proxy IP addresses or CIDR ranges. Forwarded client IP headers are ignored unless the direct connection comes from this list.
ff_debug_log_desc: Write Forum Fortress API request failures to the IPS logs.
ff_bootstrap_token_desc: Required for first-time setup. Obtain a short-lived token bound to this forum domain from a Forum Fortress administrator. It is encrypted until use and deleted after a successful bootstrap.
ff_api_key_desc: Automatically populated by authorized bootstrap or registration and encrypted using the IPS site encryption key. Leave this field blank to keep the stored credential.
ff_endpoint_state_desc: Cached fallback endpoint catalog. Normal requests always start at the GeoDNS route.
ff_registration_email_desc: Used by the Complete registration action.
ff_action_help: Save API settings below, then use these controls for portal access, attack mode, and connection tests.
ff_action_bootstrap_succeeded: Forum Fortress connection details are ready.
ff_action_bootstrap_failed: Forum Fortress could not establish a site identity. Check the endpoint settings and try again.
ff_action_test_failed: No Forum Fortress endpoint answered the connection test.
ff_action_register_failed: Forum Fortress could not complete registration. Check the registration email and connection status.
ff_action_attack_on_failed: Forum Fortress did not confirm that attack mode is active.
ff_action_attack_off_failed: Forum Fortress did not confirm that attack mode has ended.
ff_action_portal_succeeded: Forum Fortress portal access is ready.
ff_action_portal_failed: Forum Fortress could not create a portal login. Run the connection test and try again.
ff_portal_unavailable: Portal URL is not available yet. Bootstrap, save settings with a valid API key, or run the connection test first.
forumfortress_registration_blocked: Registration could not be completed at this time.
forumfortress_post_blocked: Your content could not be posted at this time.
forumfortress_contact_blocked: Your message could not be sent at this time.
approval_reason_forum_fortress: Held for review by Forum Fortress.
forumfortress_api_unreachable: The spam protection service could not be reached. Please try again shortly.
forumfortress_above_limit: Forum Fortress limits are exceeded for this site. Complete registration in the Forum Fortress portal.
forumfortress_invalid_base_url: Enter a valid HTTPS base URL without credentials, query parameters or fragments.
forumfortress_insecure_base_url: Forum Fortress endpoints must use HTTPS.
forumfortress_invalid_preferred_endpoint: The preferred endpoint must use the configured Forum Fortress host, port and transport, or a trusted ffapi.net HTTPS route.
forumfortress_invalid_trusted_proxy: Enter valid proxy IP addresses or CIDR ranges separated by commas.
forumfortress_action_requires_post: This Forum Fortress action must be submitted from the settings page.
ff_diagnostic_write_api_warning: %s API client(s) can write forum content outside native IPS events; restrict them to trusted integrations.
